item.title: ITT - Historic England response to the Flooding and Coastal Erosion Risk Management Strategy SEA - UID 395
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 15,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-11-25T09:30:00+00:00
This proposal seeks approval for a 4–6 week consultancy to help Historic England shape its response to the forthcoming Flood and Coastal Erosion Risk Management Strategy SEA consultation and to make recommendations about how Historic England can improve future engagement in the FCERM Strategy and the schemes and activities that underpin it.
